model_annotation: The provided image does not contain "Figure 1"; it contains Figure 2 and Figure 3. Figure 2 presents two line plots showing the impact of knowledge distillation weight α (left) and masking probability p (right) on dialogue translation performance on the MuST-C English-German validation set. The left plot has an x-axis labeled α ranging from 0.1 to 0.9 with linear spacing and a y-axis labeled BLEU ranging from 20.0 to 20.5. The right plot has an x-axis labeled p ranging from 0.05 to 0.45 with linear spacing and a y-axis labeled BLEU ranging from 20.0 to 29.5. Figure 3 is a single line plot showing the inconsistency of target-side probability distributions during training on the MuST-C English-German dataset, with an x-axis labeled "迭代次数" (iteration count) ranging from 0 to 30 and a y-axis labeled "目标端概率分布不一致性" (target-side probability distribution inconsistency) ranging from 0.4 to 1.2. The plot includes two lines: a blue line labeled "语音增强前" (before speech enhancement) and an orange line labeled "语音增强后" (after speech enhancement).
